items.text: Diamondbacks trade Ronny Simon to the Rays for Jordan Luplow
Athletics trade Terrence Long and Ramon Hernandez to the Padres for Mark Kotsay
Athletics trade David Newhan and Don Wengert to the Padres for Doug Bochtler and Jorge Velandia
Angels trade J.T. Snow to the Giants for Allen Watson and Fausto Macey
Yankees trade Doug Drabek, Brian Fisher and Logan Easley to the Pirates for Rick Rhoden, Cecilio Guante and Pat Clements
Orioles trade Gus Triandos and Whitey Herzog to the Tigers for Dick Brown
Yankees trade Bill Skowron to the Dodgers for Stan Williams
Red Sox trade Don Buddin to the Colts for Eddie Bressoud

note: 2026 regular-season games are not in Retrosheet yet, so 2026 here is postseason only, taken from Wikipedia's box scores. Retrosheet adds the full season after it ends.
